prompt: Design first-use, no-results, permission-denied, loading, and outage states for a project list. Each state must explain the cause honestly and provide the next useful action.
assertions: Distinguishes first-use, no-results, permission, loading, and outage.
Provides domain-specific recovery actions and accessible status communication.
Does not collapse a page state into a control state or use a spinner alone.
Every check has status, reason, remediation, evidence, and provenance; bare checkmarks and dishonest n/a are rejected.
Uses one authoritative self-check and keeps state truth stable while three runs vary structure, aesthetic treatment, and voice.

run_protocol.material_difference_requirement: Accept diversity only when each compared run cites at least two material changes across the declared axes and ties each change to the prompt or evidence; a new order, synonym, recolor, or unsupported style swap is not diversity.
run_protocol.negative_routing_requirement: The negative neighbor (component-states) must be explicitly rejected with a reason and handoff boundary.
